wayback._eras_note: Two domains: project-a.com (2012-2025; the portfolio at /portfolio/<slug>, /en/portfolio/<slug> and /de/portfolio/<slug> 2012-2019, a Next.js site from 2022) and project-a.vc (2025-2026, Next.js on the Sanity CMS read live through site_api). project-a.com/companies/<slug> (2022-2024) is the Knowledge Conference's speaker and partner directory, not the portfolio (decisions.md D8). The archive eras are parsed by scratch/archive_listings.py into sources/wayback/parsed/<year>.json with capture_url per row; no era here is a wayback-pull.py parser, so this list stays empty and the parsed files are the record.

roster._note: PRO-102's delta: Project A is an operational VC whose people namespace mixes the investment team with the operating-services staff (finance, legal, IR, and historically the value-creation unit of marketing, engineering, BI, recruiting and sales specialists). The sweep roster is constrained to the site's own 'investments' department (14 of 25 on the live CMS, 2026-09-30) unioned with the Form ADV Schedule A owners (Heinemann, Horstmann, Sander, Waitz as general partners since 2015/2016) and the partners the CMS names on portfolio boards; archived people are admitted only with an investing title. Curated in sources/wayback/partner-roster.json.

site_api._entry_stage_note: The CMS field projectInvestedAt (pre_seed / seed / series_a / series_b / private_equity) is the firm's own claim about the round it entered: eligible by semantics (COLLECTION.md s5). It rides in each queue item as stage_at_entry_site and is scored blind against the book's documented entry rounds before it labels (decisions.md D10); until then entry_stage_fields stays empty. 'private_equity' names no round and never labels.
site_api._note: www.project-a.vc is Next.js on a Sanity CMS (project nykgtoh6) whose public query API serves the whole dataset (COLLECTION.md s5 ladder step 2): 114 portfolioCompany documents with the firm's own entry year, entry round, fund, status, HQ, industries and board partner; 25 team personas with department; 44 articles; 6 funds (Fund I-V, Buyout Fund I). scratch/sanity.py re-reads any GROQ query.
site_api._entry_stage_score: Scored 2026-09-30 blind against the book's documented entry rounds (web_verified rows naming Project A's round; scratch/score_fields.py, scratch/field-score.json; decisions.md R2): the live CMS projectInvestedAt agreed on 48 of 53 (90.6%), the misses being three pre-seeds labelled seed (Baobab, Gabi, Spryker) and two Series A entries labelled seed (42matters, Homeday); the archived 2020-2024 Contentful `investment` agreed on 30 of 38 (78.9%), every miss but two a pre-seed read as Seed (that vocabulary had no pre-seed word); the 2015-2019 page line 11 of 13. Both are eligible (the firm's claim about the round IT entered) and promoted at medium (below 95%), the CMS taking precedence where both exist; private_equity, 'Venture Round', 'Joint Venture', 'Later Stage Acceleration' and 'Succession Arrangement' name no round.
site_api._team_note: www.project-a.vc/team (Sanity persona documents): 25 people in two departments; 'investments' (14: eight partners, a principal, investment managers and associates) publishes, 'operations' (11: CFO, general counsel, finance, IR, assistants) is left unmapped so it does not publish. LinkedIn links are the CMS row's own.
